name: Mural MCP Server
description: Lets AI assistants create, read, and organize Mural canvases for product, research, and workshop teams, through Mural's official remote MCP server (paid plans).

skills.name: Canvas Creation
skills.description: Creates a canvas for a project, planning session, or initiative.

skills.name: Canvas Organization
skills.description: Adds stickies, shapes, text, connectors, and areas, and arranges them into sections and groups.

skills.name: Research Synthesis
skills.description: Groups similar ideas, identifies recurring themes, and summarizes research or team input into one shared view.

skills.name: Workshop Boards
skills.description: Generates a ready-to-facilitate workshop board from a problem statement, requirements, and existing documentation.

skills.name: Decision Capture
skills.description: Captures decisions, action items, and next steps on the canvas so the assistant can move them into other tools it can access.
